# Part IV: Working in a Team {.unnumbered .part}

The report builds on your machine. A colleague clones the repository and it does not: a
package you installed by hand, a file you never committed. Then the client's data arrive, and
they may not be shown to the agent that built everything so far. Neither is a failure of the
method. They are the two things one person's computer hides: whether the work rebuilds
anywhere, and what may leave the building. This part takes the Acme project to both.

**@sec-team, Pull Requests and Builds You Can Trust.** Rules for a team's agents, a pull
request template, and one build that checks every pull request, publishes the site and
renders the monthly reports.

**@sec-at-work, At Work and in a Start-up.** What leaves your computer when an agent works,
confidential data, proxies, and what a start-up should build this way.

The first chapter continues the repository from checkpoint 19 and ends at checkpoint 20; the
second is reading, with no new files.
